name: Rolling Stone
description: Rolling Stone is a lively and agile Tabaxi who seamlessly blends the rhythmic, poetic soul of a bard with the disciplined, lightning-fast kinetic strikes of a monk. With sleek, wind-swept fur and soft-padded paws that make virtually no sound on cobblestone or wooden floorboards, they travel from tavern to tavern playing hypnotic acoustic melodies on a lute while keeping their reflexes razor-sharp for any sudden trouble.
ideals: Harmony: 'Life is like a complex rhythm; keep your steps light, your heart open, and never miss a beat.'
Freedom: 'A rolling stone gathers no moss, and a true wanderer never stays bound by walls or worry.'
bonds: The open road, musical camaraderie, and fellow adventurers who appreciate a good tune and a reliable ally.
The sacred martial arts traditions and traveling artistic troupes that shaped their upbringing.
flaws: Restless and easily distracted by new rumors, distant horizons, or shiny musical novelties.
Occasional bouts of feline curiosity that pull them into unnecessary dangerous situations.
speech_patterns: Melodic, playful, and casually philosophical, frequently slipping musical cadence or feline idioms into everyday conversation.
mannerisms: Tapping rhythmic beats with long claws, casually stretching with feline grace, strumming absentminded melodies on their instrument, and darting away with astonishing speed when startled.
motivations: To collect the finest songs, stories, and martial techniques from across the Sword Coast.
To protect friends and innocent bystanders with a sudden, devastating flurry of unarmed strikes hidden behind a charming smile.
knowledge: Familiarity with regional tavern circuits, folk songs, gossip, open-hand combat maneuvers, and acrobatic navigation across urban rooftops.
gm_notes: Rolling Stone serves as a vibrant, dynamic character who brings incredible mobility, musical flair, and unexpected combat prowess to the table. They can easily liven up a tavern scene, provide performance utility, or scout rooftops with unmatched stealth.
